g.text: TRUST ZONE — O'Reilly (third party, NOT ours)

ul.li: Spoofing → scoped Bearer token, not an ambient cookie
Information disclosure → classify data; passage is transient; secrets stay server-side
Elevation of privilege → scope check at the enforcement point

text.tspan: I: disclosure/ToS → classify, transient, never persist
S: spoof → scoped token · T/I → TLS · E: elevation → server scope check
R: repudiation → activity ledger = audit trail
